title: Resolve marching-squares saddle cells with the cell-centre average
description: Source: src/geodesk/terrain.py `ContourGenerator._cell_segments` — TODO(#1). Saddle cells (4 edge crossings) always pair north-west and south-east, which can join the wrong contour on ridges. Use the average of the 4 corners to choose the pairing. Acceptance: test with a saddle DEM where the centre is above the level produces the opposite pairing. Labels: terrain, FR-09

title: Read large DEMs in row blocks instead of loading them into memory
description: Source: src/geodesk/terrain.py `ContourGenerator._check_dem` — TODO(#2). arc42 B5.2.2 requires block-wise reading so a 200 MB DEM does not exhaust RAM. Acceptance: 50 MB DEM contoured in < 8 s with peak memory < 500 MB (FR-09 verification). Labels: terrain, performance, NFR-01

title: Reproject GeoJSON export to EPSG:4326
description: Source: src/geodesk/terrain.py `ContourLayer.to_geojson` — TODO(#3). RFC 7946 requires WGS84 coordinates, but the export keeps the DEM CRS (UTM 48N).
